title: Three-body superposition: do pair couplings add at separation 5?
pitch: A, B, C at rest on an equilateral triangle of side 5. If pair couplings add, each particle's initial acceleration is the sum over its two partners of K_i(j)/5^2.5 along the pair direction, using P-0005 values (A on B 8.99, A on C -8.77, B on A 12.34, B on C -6.10, C on A -21.25, C on B -10.59). Each measured N=2 coupling is already in P-0005; the N=3 sum is not yet tested. Tracker noise ~0.05 per coordinate. T=2.
